fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge dimension adequacy for cyclists and pushchair users at busy A4019 crossings is a recognised, scheme-relevant Stage 1 safety issue, not vacuous.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote EV-UK-015 directly supports the pivotal claim that undersized refuges expose cyclists to being clipped; bus-stop demand element rests on recorded scheme context rather than invention.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a Stage 1 safety concern with a forward check into detailed design, kept categorically distinct from any compliance assertion, with no normative basis claimed.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: names locations (each A4019 crossing adjacent the bus stop), design users (expectant parent with pushchair and cycle), and the parameter to provide (depth and width).
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists and pushchair users are explicitly addressed in both the scenario and the recommendation, matching the relevant VRU exposure at these crossings.

justifications.substance: Stop-line repositioning beside the Homecroft Drive junction could invalidate recorded large-vehicle turning envelopes that already exhibit over-run into opposing lanes, so pre-Stage-2 revalidation carries genuine scheme-specific safety weight.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal swept-path claim is anchored by a verbatim quote (EV-UK-002 explicitly naming the refuse vehicle, 7.5t box van and the over-run limitation), while stop-line repositioning is presented as a recorded input fact, so no content is invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as a compliance_question kept categorically separate from asserted safety problems, with its normative basis framed as an exception-check analog of GG 119 problem-location recording and VRU matters explicitly scoped out.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation names the precise analysis to redo (large-vehicle swept paths), the trigger geometry (as-adjusted stop-line positions), and the deadline (before Stage 2), making it specific, actionable and viable.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists, central refuges and recorded desire lines are acknowledged as present and relevant, but the finding defers all VRU-specific exposure without examining over-run/crossing interactions, so it earns acknowledgement-level credit only.
